subject.title: [F10] openclaw.end_reason always empty on session.ended spans

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw.end_reason` session termination contract, and should it be emitted on trajectory `session.ended`, diagnostics-otel spans, or both?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the enum names and exported surface become an operator-facing telemetry contract that automation should not invent without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Shared End-Reason Contract
options.body: Define the enum once, map existing terminal signals into it, and emit it on the approved trajectory and OTel surfaces with docs and tests.

options.title: Scope To Existing Outcome Fields
options.body: Keep `openclaw.outcome` and errorCategory as the supported public fields and clarify the docs instead of adding a new attribute.

options.title: Fold Into Related Telemetry Work
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102018 as the broader session terminal telemetry project and resolve this request there.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared End-Reason Contract
recommendation.body: Define the enum once, map existing terminal signals into it, and emit it on the approved trajectory and OTel surfaces with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checked-out implementation history points to steipete for the trajectory and diagnostics-otel surfaces involved in this contract choice.
